summary: Elephant and fort civ, near the bottom of Valdy's tier list. Tughlaq players attack with healer elephants via the Dome of the Faith, or go 2 TC with a fort against slow civs.
openings: Healer elephant aggression via the Dome of the Faith.
2 TC with a fort against Malians.
Spear or tower rush against Sengoku.

spikes.label: Healer elephants
spikes.detail: Healer elephants keep their Feudal army alive.
spikes.answer: Mass archers and spears, and focus the healers.

spikes.label: Ballista Elephants
spikes.detail: Ballista Elephants are cheaper and faster to train this patch.

scout: Dome of the Faith means healer elephant aggression
A Tughlaqabad Fort with a second Town Center means 2 TC
